create_panoptic_evaluator: create a PanopticEvaluator instance with annotation file, annotation folder, and output directory
update_predictions: update the PanopticEvaluator with new predictions that include file names and png strings
synchronize_predictions: synchronize predictions across all processes using the PanopticEvaluator synchronize_between_processes method
summarize_evaluation: summarize panoptic evaluation results by writing predictions JSON and computing PQ metrics
review_panoptic_evaluator_class: review the PanopticEvaluator class and its update, synchronize, and summarize methods
